name: Sample-and-hold / random-glide LFO textures: random steps on pitch, wave position and filter, random glide squelch, user-drawn step LFO
goal: Use a random-hold (sample-and-hold) LFO as a sound-design engine: random stepped pitch on a saw (sci-fi computer with reverb/delay), the same LFO on wave/wavetable tuning and filter cutoff/resonance, a random-glide shape with legato + glide for squelchy psy-style lines, mod-wheel-scaled S&H on volume, and a user-defined 8-step (steps or lines) LFO as a repeatable pseudo-S&H for bass/leads — then bounce and chop the audio into SFX. Delta beyond general LFO routing and random pitch drift in pad skills.

source.title: Zebra 2 - Using LFO`s Random Features (Sample & Hold) - How To Tutorial

prerequisites: Synth with an LFO offering random/sample-and-hold, random-glide and user-drawable step shapes
Mod matrix with mod-wheel scaling; reverb + delay

outputs.name: sh_textures
outputs.description: Bounced random textures for chopping into SFX

constraints: Original synthesis recipe; not affiliated with any vendor named in the source. Recreate in browser/Web Audio (Polyrhythm Studio) or any hybrid synth with comparable modules; no presets, banks or samples copied.
High resonance with random cutoff can spike levels — keep depth and resonance in check.
Concept (S&H): the LFO samples a random/source value at each step and holds it until the next.

steps.action: On a basic saw oscillator, set LFO2 shape to random-hold (sample and hold) and route LFO2 → oscillator tune.
Add reverb and delay (adjust delay times) for the old sci-fi computer effect.
Swap to a stranger oscillator wave; keep the pitch depth low so it stays usable (even as a weird bassline).
Route the same LFO2 to the wave/wavetable position (with the wave set mid) as well as tune; add lots of delay.
Add a filter and route the S&H LFO to cutoff and resonance — be careful with high resonance.
steps.expect: Random filter jumps; loud peaks if resonance too high

steps.action: Switch LFO shape to random glide; set legato mode and turn glide up for squelchy random glides (psytrance-style). Note long sustained notes vs retriggered behaviour; speed the LFO up as needed.
In the mod matrix, target voice volume with LFO2 scaled by the mod wheel.
steps.expect: Mod wheel fades in random volume chopping

steps.action: Use a user-defined LFO with 8 steps as a predetermined S&H pattern (it repeats, so not truly random) for basslines or leads; switch steps → lines so glide ramps between values.
Bounce results to audio and chop short sections for SFX and quirky elements.

verification: Random-hold produces audible discrete steps; random glide produces smooth slides.
User 8-step LFO pattern repeats identically each cycle.
Mod wheel at 0 removes the volume modulation.
